auth_details: Optional API key via api_key query parameter or x-api-key header; free self-serve registration at the portal. Unauthenticated requests allowed at lower rate limits.
free_tier_limits: Free with optional key; higher limits with registered key (exact quotas from portal)
rate_limits: Published on MBTA developer portal; typically lower without key, higher with registered API key
description: Official Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority (MBTA) V3 API delivering real-time predictions, vehicle locations, schedules, routes, stops, alerts, and related transit data for the Boston area in JSON:API format. Built on GTFS and GTFS-Realtime concepts with a free public tier and optional API key for higher rate limits.
